units: kW, kWh, EUR; schematic coordinates in metres
objective: Annualised pipe investment + full-year variable generation cost
variables: Binary pipe choices, hourly pipe flows and producer heat output
constraints: At most one type per route; nodal heat balance with losses; pipe and producer capacities; no shortage
method: DHNx investment master with exact annual Benders cuts; only identical load states combined
generation: Constant electricity price and COP; hypothetical free, continuously available waste heat
network: Constant losses on built pipes; all candidate routes re-optimised; no sunk assets
limitations: No hydraulic, temperature, ramping, storage, outage or environmental model
